verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Claude can connect to existing remote MCP servers as custom connectors and can use custom-built ones (claude-docs-31, claude-docs-36, claude-docs-33). Claude Desktop also supports installing local MCP servers 'as easily as browser extensions' (claude-docs-51, claude-docs-64), and a unified directory lists installable connectors (claude-docs-17). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that MCP tool use works in practice, and documentation detail on per-surface and per-plan availability and tool permissioning.
